dedupe_keys.name: tracerpro as path and peering aware topology preparation tools

description: tracerpro prepares candidate autonomous-system paths from public internet relationship information. The maintainer publishes crawlers, graph-search tools and a segment checker that compares inferred relationships with observed traceroutes. The peers-aware variant includes peer tables, bounded neighbour searches and path-diversity rules to address limitations found in earlier breadth-first search. Geographic coverage follows the input routing graph; the documented validation on 23 August 2026 uses one captured trace from a Libyan network. Python code is publicly accessible free under MIT. A limitation is that the reported corpus of approximately 117,000 ASN snapshots is deliberately absent from the repository, so reproducing large-scale results requires obtaining inputs separately. The provider’s own validation notes identify one unsupported adjacency and confine evidence to a single trace. Simulation uses include preparing alternative interdomain paths and studying uncertainty in topology inputs. No related catalogue resource was identified as this software or its unavailable corpus. Inferred links are hypotheses, not measured peering arrangements. Neither crawlers nor path-analysis scripts were run, and no live network probes or topology downloads were performed.
name: tracerpro AS-path and peering-aware topology preparation tools
notes: G8; G8-0254. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: Repository documentation. No describing paper identified in the inspected metadata..
